detailed: Grafana Labs is hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer for its Product Analytics team in Ireland (remote) to build and scale a native experimentation platform.
The experimentation tool started as a hackathon project, runs internal A/B tests, and is slated to be offered to Grafana Cloud customers.
The role involves hands-on production engineering, partnering with data scientists and engineers on event pipelines, feature flags, and data warehouses.
Base compensation in Ireland ranges from EUR 107,000 to EUR 134,000, supplemented by Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and an AI coding assistant budget.

Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Ireland | Remote
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.
Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs.
We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P.
Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.
Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work.
Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay.
If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.
It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments.

The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.
You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them.
As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes.

You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions.
This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code.

We invest heavily in developer productivity.

You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.
We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards.
You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.
In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 107,000 - EUR 134,000.
Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process.
All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success.

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
